The Muse headquarters is located in Toronto. Those who need ot contact the company by post should send their letter to the following Muse address: InteraXon Inc., 555 Richmond St West, Suite 900, Toronto, Ontario M5V 3B1, Canada. If you need a quick resolution of your issue, it’s better to call or send an email.

### 

The corporate support representatives provide assistance Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST. Please note that the company is closed on Canadian holidays, and all inquiries and issues received on these days are addressed once the company is back to work again.
